Droguería del Sud
(often spelled
Droguería del Sud
) is a major wholesale distributor of pharmaceuticals and hospital supplies in Argentina, serving thousands of pharmacies. While they supply general pharmaceutical products and basic medical-surgical items,
they do not specialize in selling or distributing advanced consumer or clinical wearable medical devices
(such as smart heart monitors, continuous glucose patches, or remote biometric tech bands).
Drogueria Del Sud
Overview of Services
Core Business:
Wholesale distribution of prescription drugs, over-the-counter medications, toiletries, and standard pharmacy sundries.
Client Base:
Directly supplies pharmacies and health centers rather than individual retail consumers.
Product Scope:
Focuses on consumable medical supplies and pharmaceuticals rather than high-tech patient wearables.
